widgets_values:
in order to use the automatic description:


INSTALL OLLAMA ON YOUR COMPUTER

model used qwen 3.5  2b   (around 1.9gb)


run this command on your ollama model folder:


ollama run huihui_ai/qwen3.5-abliterated:2B


put your ref on 16 : 9 ratio !

nodes.title: FAQ
widgets_values:
# LTX 2.5

**Where do I download these models??**

models, vae, text encoders, Loras, upscaler, download links here: <https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/tree/main>



The tiny vae (taeltx2_3.safetensors) is found here:
<https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors>

**I'm getting errors when running this workflow!**

Double check that you have all of the correct models loaded. This is using the newest version of 2x upscaler (v1.1). You can change it to the older one under the Model Loader.

Msr Lora : 

<https://huggingface.co/LiconStudio/LTX-2.3-Multiple-Subject-Reference/resolve/main/LTX-2.3-Licon-MSR-V2.safetensors?download=true>

properties.global_prompt: Cinematic sci-fi, one continuous take. He steps down off the fallen trunk and walks deeper into the ferns, boots pressing into soaked moss, one hand pushing a low hanging branch aside as he passes. The camera follows from behind in a slow handheld push, drifting a little to the left, until he sits in a medium shot on the right of frame with the misted canopy open behind him. He slows, then stops — his head turning down toward a soft blue glow low in the undergrowth ahead, the same cold blue as the lamps on his pack. He lowers himself into a crouch, one knee sinking into the moss, and reaches a bare hand toward it; the glow lifts across his jaw and the wet sleeve of his jacket, and his shoulders drop as his breathing slows. He holds there, hand hovering just above the light, fingers not quite touching it. Audio: dense wet forest ambience throughout — water dripping from branches, distant birdcalls, wind moving high in the canopy; close boot squelch and fabric rustle while he walks, easing into slow breathing as he crouches. A low sustained synth drone rises underneath in the last seconds and holds to the end.
